atoms.text:
Act II, Scene II

(Setting: Mayor Magnolia sits on the ground of the animal shelter surrounded by dogs.)

Mayor Magnolia: (taking off the leashes of the dogs) Oh yes, I am good. Really, really good. (laughs happily) Everyone will love me, everyone will know I am the best dog trainer around. (laughs again and throws a toy for the dogs) And they thought they were punishing me by making me help out at the animal shelter. Little did they know, (shouting) I AM AN AMAZING DOG TRAINER! And you are an amazing dog, little Hank. (gives Hank the dog some treats)

(Mayor Magnolia stands up from the ground and paces, laughing happily all the while. After some time, Magnolia walks to Hank and gives him belly rubs.)

Mayor Magnolia: (gesturing to all of the dogs around her) Ah yes, all of you will all be adopted into loving families. (laughs again) Every single one of you will be (screaming the word) ADOPTED! (pauses) I will invite the whole town to the dog show, and they will see how smart and loveable you all are. I am the best dog trainer after all, I can help any dog find a family. Afterwards, the people will have no choice but to make me the head of the animal shelter. Yes, and then I will use the donations to turn this place into a magical, wonderful place for animals… (trails off into thought) What a perfect plan for a brighter future!

(The lights dim until the stage is fully dark, while Mayor Magnolia’s happy laughter becomes louder, the dogs and cats are barking and meowing in the background.)
